title: Scions of Thundercrest
summary: Find the hidden tomes and use their words to challenge the three scions.
overview: Find the hidden tomes and use their words to challenge the three scions.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Loot the matching tome before speaking its phrase and prepare before each challenge.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Three sealed chests appear at distinct random locations.
After satisfying the matching tome task objective, say 'Kor Lal Lir Toval' to the Wind, 'Vek Lal Lir Qualal' to the Storm, and 'Nil Lal Lir Keval' to the Sky.
A valid challenge removes that scion's protection and starts combat.
